text:
Priya (Mirrorix): Hey team — Mirrorix would like to onboard a multi-model pipeline for legal doc summarization + a reranker. Requirements: private deployment, HSM/KMS, PHI/PII scrubbing, explainability traces, and a canary rollout. Target go-live: May 12 (next quarter). Any major blockers?

Amelia (CS): Thanks Priya. Quick clarifying q's: will Mirrorix host data in their VPC or ship to our dedicated infra? Also need expected QPS and avg doc size.

Priya (Mirrorix): Data stays in their VPC (we'll do private deployment). QPS ~4 peak, avg doc ~12k tokens, many scanned PDFs (OCR noise). They want a canary that serves 10% traffic, then ramp.

Raj (SE): For 12k-token inputs we should plan chunking + prefix cache. Recommend a 13B quantized summarizer and a small 2B reranker for latency. Need eval sets (200-500 labeled examples) to validate quality.

Priya (Mirrorix): I'll upload a 250-example eval set to their S3 bucket this afternoon (s3://mirrorix/onboard/evals). They also require per-output trace logs for explainability.

Tobi (Safety): PHI/PII filtering is mandatory. We'll run the privacy-scrub pipeline and an adversarial injection test. Also need model abstain/reject policy and escalation matrix from Mirrorix legal.

Evan (Account Lead): Heads up — the renewal conversation is in 6 months. This onboarding is high-impact for expansion. We should lock an enablement workshop for product + support teams.

Amelia (CS): I'll draft the runbook, quickstart, and a training agenda. Proposed workshop: next Tue 10am PT. Priya, does that work?

Priya (Mirrorix): That works. Also one constraint: Mirrorix legal prefers DFARS-aligned deployment. If we need on-prem/air-gap, timeline might shift.

Raj (SE): Note: on-prem with HSM increases ops complexity. If they insist, we should add ~3 extra weeks for infra readiness. Otherwise private VPC deployment with HSM keys is fastest.

Amelia (CS): Ops checklist I'm capturing: 
```
- Confirm VPC peering & routing
- Provision KMS/HSM keys with Mirrorix tenant
- Validate S3 access + least-priv IAM roles
- Upload + sanity-check eval dataset
- Canary policy (10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- Observability: token-level perf + explainability traces
```

ops-bot: Ticket created: RWINF-4821 for Mirrorix onboarding. Assignee: Raj. Initial PoC ETA: 2 weeks.

Tobi (Safety): I'll produce a safety checklist draft (dataflow, redaction, abstain thresholds) by EOD+3. If DFARS required, list extra controls and approvals.

Evan (Account Lead): I'll update account health doc and mark a potential renewal risk if on-prem is required (timeline + cost impact).

Priya (Mirrorix): Thanks all — I'll share the evals, dataflow diagram, and legal template before EOD. Appreciate the quick turnaround :thumbsup:
